sections.content: Key realization: the blue top-bar is a **game-over indicator**, not a countdown timer. It filled to full-blue when I clicked the blue ball (the actual lose trigger), and it's now recovering (blue 60→59, gray 1→2 per action). So there's no time pressure — I just must **avoid clicking the blue ball**. The puzzle is the T-bars. Let me try a new candidate I haven't tested: left-aligned ∩/U (both rows = `BBBBw`, T1–T4 lit, T5 off).

def state():
    c = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    return ''.join(c[42][x] for x in cols), ''.join(c[45][x] for x in cols)
print('before:', state())
# target both = BBBBw : top needs T1,T2,T4 -> B ; stem needs T2,T4 -> B
seq=[{'action':'MOUSE','row':42,'col':21},{'action':'MOUSE','row':42,'col':26},{'action':'MOUSE','row':42,'col':36},
     {'action':'MOUSE','row':45,'col':26},{'action':'MOUSE','row':45,'col':36}]
r = action(seq)
print('after :', state())
print('res:', {k:v for k,v in last_action_result.items() if k in ('board_changed','done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete','reward')})
</parameter>
</function>
